description: This class defines a DigitalProduct entity representing a digital product in an e-commerce system. It includes mappings for database persistence using JPA annotations, with fields such as id, product, and productFileName, along with getters and setters.

classes.name: DigitalProduct
classes.description: An entity representing a digital product associated with a physical product, including database mappings and fields for file name and product reference.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the digital product.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the digital product.

methods.name: getProductFileName
methods.description: Retrieves the filename of the digital product.

methods.name: setProductFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename of the digital product.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a Product entity with this digital product.
